summary: Iteration 109 — XOS Multi-surface Layout Engine (Etapa 1.2) + Role Experience Manager (Etapa 1.3) tested. Backend: 17/17 tests pass — specialist_home layout returns 5 widgets, admin surfaces returns 2 surfaces with correct labels/widgets, PUT/reset persists, experience profile GET/PUT/restore works for all 3 roles, tenant_id=main present on all 10 registry entries, unknown role/surface → 404, invalid entry_route → 400. Frontend: SpecialistDashboard regression PASS — XOS-driven opportunities tab renders today_summary (KPI grid 5 items OK), cockpit, quests, tier_tools, tier_progress correctly. Admin XOS Builder surface selector switches between client_home and specialist_home, both show correct widget lists, drag/toggle/save/reset per surface all functional. E2E XOS PASS — admin disabled quests on specialist_home → saved → specialist re-login confirmed Quest-uri panel not rendered while today_summary still visible → reset restored (verified via API). UI Rules widget target dropdown includes all specialist widgets (today_summary, cockpit, quests, tier_tools, tier_progress). Client dashboard + homepage + mobile menu regression PASS. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: ExperienceProfilesPanel is imported in XOSBuilderPage.jsx (line 8) but NEVER rendered in JSX — admin has ZERO UI access to the Role Experience Manager (Etapa 1.3 feature). Backend endpoints work; only frontend rendering gap.

minor.issue: Endpoint is public (no auth) — anyone can read entry_route/default_theme/layout_surface per role. Currently used by SiteNav to resolve /dashboard for logged users; safe today but consider requiring auth if these become sensitive.

Partial updates supported (only fields present are updated) — no validation that at least one of the required fields is included after sanitization; 400 raised correctly when all are invalid. Behavior OK but should be documented.

ui_bugs.issue: ExperienceProfilesPanel is imported at line 8 but NEVER rendered anywhere in the JSX return tree (only <XOSRegistryPanel> at line 115). The Role Experience Manager admin UI (data-testid=experience-profiles-panel with exp-save-client/specialist/admin buttons) is completely inaccessible from any page. There is also no /admin/experience-profiles route in App.js and no menu link. Etapa 1.3 admin panel is orphaned code.

action_items: URGENT — Render ExperienceProfilesPanel inside XOSBuilderPage.jsx: add <ExperienceProfilesPanel /> in the JSX (e.g. right after <XOSRegistryPanel onChanged={...} /> at line 115). Alternatively create a dedicated /admin/experience-profiles route (App.js) and menu entry (AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx). Without this, spec item 'exp-save-client etc.' cannot be tested and Etapa 1.3 admin control is dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: XOSBuilderPage.jsx line 8: unused import ExperienceProfilesPanel — either wire it into the page or delete the import. Lint would catch (no-unused-vars) if strictness turned up.
xos.py _get_profile line 296: correctly falls back to DEFAULT_PROFILES + overlays saved doc; simple/clean.
xos.py admin_put_profile line 318: `layout_surface: ''` treated as valid (unset). Good for admin role. Ok pattern.
SiteNav.jsx line 63: entryRoute fetched on user change; nice UX. But dashboard href line 178 fallback is `/${user.role}` which duplicates default profile — acceptable defensive coding.

SpecialistDashboard.jsx line 65: xosHidden fetch fires on mount but not re-fired when user changes/logs out — minor: if a specialist logs in as another role in same tab, stale rules could apply. Fire-and-forget acceptable for now.

SpecialistDashboard.jsx line 136-138: tier-gated widgets (quests/tier_tools) return null when user tier is too low. Good separation — 'XOS disable' and 'tier gate' are independent, both must allow render.
xos.py registry _ensure_registry_seed line 46-54: iterates each surface separately; O(N surfaces) but N=2 today — fine. If N grows, batch insert would be better.
Frontend consumers of surfaces don't await ExperienceProfilesPanel data (uses local load()) — no issue but could show a small skeleton state.

rca of the issue: XOSBuilderPage.jsx: developer added the import line 8 (`import ExperienceProfilesPanel from './ExperienceProfilesPanel';`) but forgot to render `<ExperienceProfilesPanel />` in the JSX return tree. The panel file itself is correctly implemented (data-testid=experience-profiles-panel, 3 rows with exp-save-{role} buttons wiring to PUT /api/admin/experience-profiles/{role}). Repro: as admin GET /admin/xos-builder → search DOM for `experience-profiles-panel` → count=0. Fix (1 line): inside the last <div> of XOSBuilderPage return, right after `<XOSRegistryPanel .../>` at line 115, add `<ExperienceProfilesPanel />`. No backend change needed — backend endpoints tested and working (GET /api/admin/experience-profiles returns {profiles:[client,specialist,admin], themes:['dark','light','system'], surfaces:['client_home','specialist_home']}; PUT /api/admin/experience-profiles/{role} persists correctly).
